finding: The flag-change event is NOT present in any held-out capture (only flagd evaluation calls in proxy logs) and traces carry no span status. Localising product-catalog with confidence is therefore impossible from these captures; a recapture with the production collectors is required for a real-data localisation test (roadmap M10).

confident_wrong_if: classification in (PLAUSIBLE, CONFIRMED) naming any root cause (false alarm on a healthy system)
expected.rationale: No fault injected. Change feed and baseline window are absent from the capture, so INSUFFICIENT (coverage) is also honest.

confident_wrong_if: classification == CONFIRMED (propagation cannot be evaluated: no span status in capture)
classification == NO_ANOMALY (a fault was active)
a root service other than product-catalog is named at PLAUSIBLE or above (e.g. frontend, the symptom)
mechanism == change_induced while no change event is present in the snapshot
expected.rationale: Capture contains frontend 5xx metrics, frontend-proxy access logs and status-less traces in which product-catalog appears as a callee. The flag change is absent. Honest best output: INSUFFICIENT naming product-catalog as the next thing to check, or PLAUSIBLE product-catalog if trace structure alone supports it.
